job: Show a screenshot, video or diagram in a captioned frame that can open larger.
purpose: A figure with a media area, an optional caption and a placeholder when there is no image yet. With data-zoom, activating the media opens a dialog with a copy of it. The 16:9 ratio is a preference: a placeholder that holds more grows to fit it, and nothing is clipped.
useWhen: A docs page shows a screen of the product or a demo video.
A figure needs a caption and the option to look closer.

avoidWhen.when: An image inside a chat message.

states.name: zoomable
states.how: data-zoom; the media gets a zoom-in cursor

variants.useWhen: The reader may open the media in a dialog.
A 21:9 placeholder for a wide banner screenshot.

parts.role: The image, video or placeholder; focusable when zoomable.
A play mark over a video placeholder.

keyboard.does: Opens a zoomable frame in a dialog.
